key_results: 10 cm composite shield (20% B4C in polymer) reduces surface dose to 1.98 mSv/h (SSR-6 compliant); thermal neutron absorption 99.69% at 0.99 cm; MCNP vs experiment deviation <7%
comments: Comprehensive multi-code validation is rigorous; fabricated material characterization via SEM/elemental mapping adds confidence but cost-effectiveness not addressed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cm-244 dominates neutron source after 5 years cooling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; accounts for 98.2% spontaneous fission, 97.6% total neutron source

hypotheses.hypothesis: 20% B4C composite provides adequate shielding to SSR-6 limits
hypotheses.result: Validated; surface dose meets 2 mSv/h requirement

title: FMR analysis by machine learning leads to remarkable insights into the magnetic anisotropy of $$\text {Co}_{{25}}\text {Fe}_{{75}}$$ thin films
task: Simultaneously analyze broadband and fixed-frequency FMR data via machine learning
key_results: ML global optimization yields consistent magnetic anisotropy parameters (frequency-independent); traditional fitting produces 7% discrepancies; enables direct g-factor and magnetization extraction
comments: Machine learning resolves real inconsistency in FMR analysis but method generalization to other thin film systems not fully demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Global ML optimization across all frequencies yields consistent parameters vs separate broadband/fixed-frequency analysis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; eliminates 7% discrepancy in anisotropy parameters

hypotheses.hypothesis: FMR alone suffices to extract g-factor and magnetization with ML optimization
hypotheses.result: Validated; results consistent with independent measurements

title: Vibration control of a variable-size beam supported manipulator system based on nonlinear energy sink
task: Optimize nonlinear energy sink design for vibration control of variable-size beam manipulators
key_results: NES with cubic nonlinearity suppresses maximum steady-state response; HB-AFT analysis yields optimal design criteria; optimal parameters minimize amplitude throughout assembly process
comments: Parametric optimization is systematic but limited to fixed beam geometry; transient response and robustness to parameter variations deserves attention.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cubic NES effectively suppresses higher steady-state amplitudes vs linear absorber
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via HB-AFT harmonic balance analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parametric optimization yields NES settings valid throughout beam assembly process
hypotheses.result: Validated; design guidelines established

title: Tunable Tamm plasmon polaritons in the terahertz range using highly doped InSb as the plasmonic layer
task: Engineer tunable Tamm plasmon polaritons in THz using doped InSb
key_results: Tamm-type resonance in Si/TPX DBR with InSb plasmonic layer; resonance frequency tunable via carrier concentration; strong field confinement and enhanced reflectance dip
comments: Device concept is sound but experimental validation in THz regime is missing; realistic material models improve credibility.

model_io.model: InSb/DBR heterostructure (Si/TPX DBR with InSb spacer)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Carrier concentration controls Tamm resonance position via Drude permittivity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; plasma frequency shifts directly with doping level

hypotheses.hypothesis: DBR stop band provides photonic confinement for Tamm state
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated strong electric field enhancement inside stop band

title: Uncertainty analysis of spatiotemporal wake characteristics in groove-flap wind turbines based on turbulence intensity
task: Analyze spatiotemporal wake evolution in VAWTs under varying turbulence
key_results: DMD reveals baseline VAWT stable at low turbulence (0.1%), groove-flap VAWT superior at high turbulence (15%); wake mixing increases with turbulence intensity
comments: DMD analysis is appropriate but lacks dynamic stall characterization and power output metrics essential for practical deployment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Baseline VAWT suitable for low-turbulence; groove-flap for urban high-turbulence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via spatiotemporal wake stability analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Groove-flap enhances wake mixing through localized perturbations
hypotheses.result: Validated; shows improved adaptability to unsteady inflow

title: Step-graded AlGaN barrier engineering in AlGaN/GaN HEMTs for high-linearity low-noise RF amplifiers
task: Optimize AlGaN barrier composition and thickness for RF HEMT linearity
key_results: Step-graded AlGaN/GaN HEMT with 11 nm barrier achieves gm=420.4 mS/mm, fT=154.3 GHz, suppressed nonlinearity; 25%→15% Al gradient improves transconductance uniformity
comments: Systematic material engineering is well-executed but results are incremental improvements over prior designs; practical fabrication tolerances not thoroughly discussed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Step-graded barrier produces more distributed 2DEG confinement and improved linearity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SG-HEMT shows suppressed higher-order nonlinearities vs conventional HEMT

hypotheses.hypothesis: Thinner barrier (11 nm vs 22 nm) enhances DC/RF performance
hypotheses.result: Validated; optimized geometry yields higher fT and drive current

title: Stochastic models indicate rapid smallpox spread and mass mortality of Indigenous Australians after colonial exposure
task: Determine smallpox entry point and spread dynamics in colonial Australia
key_results: Stochastic models support southeastern Australian entry (not northern); estimated ~220,000 deaths in affected regions assuming 60% lethality; disease unlikely to spread Australia-wide from initial 1789 epidemic
comments: Models effectively integrate historical constraints with epidemiological principles, though demographic estimates depend heavily on assumed lethality parameter and pre-contact population distributions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Smallpox entered via pre-colonial Makassan trade on northern coast
hypotheses.result: Rejected; simulations show disease unlikely to reach Sydney from northern entry even under ideal conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Smallpox entered via British First Fleet in southeastern Australia (1788)
hypotheses.result: Supported by model simulations

title: A bioenergetic understanding of “aerobic glycolysis”
task: Clarify bioenergetic basis and physiological role of aerobic glycolysis
key_results: Aerobic glycolysis is a kinetically regulated component of dual ATP supply pathways (glycolysis + mitochondrial respiration) responding to cellular ATP demand, not a pathological contingency
comments: Conceptual recalibration addressing terminology drift; strengthens the hypothesis-testing framework but lacks new quantitative experimental validation of the proposed bioenergetic model.

model_io.model: Bioenergetic model of dual ATP supply

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aerobic glycolysis operates as a kinetically regulated system meeting variable cellular ATP demand
hypotheses.result: Supported by bioenergetic framework review; clarifies that aerobic glycolysis is physiological, not pathological
